meta.title: PDPP RI Public-Contract Inventory (B-minimum)
meta.coverage_caveat: testFilesByOpIdName is a WEAK by-name signal; tests build URLs dynamically & call operation modules directly. 0 != untested. Behavioral: aggregate=31, blob=49, search=35, field_not_granted=10, ambiguous_connection=10, content_ladder=0.
meta.error_envelope: { error:{ type, code, message, param?, available_connections?, retry_with?, resource_metadata?(401), next_step?(401), request_id } } via server/request-helpers.js pdppError()

mcp_tools.name: schema
mcp_tools.semantics: grant-scoped capability doc; compact default; full only with stream; discovery ladder schema->schema(stream)->schema(stream,connection_id)->query_records

mcp_tools.name: query_records
mcp_tools.input: { stream, limit?<=100, cursor?, order?, sort?, count?, filter?, fields?, view?, expand?, expand_limit?, changes_since?, connection_id? } .strict()
mcp_tools.semantics: default 25; limit>100->limit_clamped/capped; content[] previews first 5; content_ladder for long fields

mcp_tools.name: aggregate
mcp_tools.input: { stream, metric(count|sum|min|max|count_distinct), field?, group_by? XOR group_by_time?, granularity?, time_zone?, limit?<=100, filter?, connection_id? } .strict()
mcp_tools.semantics: never returns record bodies; grouped includes other_count

mcp_tools.name: search
mcp_tools.input: { q, streams?, limit?<=100, cursor?, mode?(lexical|semantic|hybrid), filter?, connection_id? } .strict()
mcp_tools.semantics: hit ids self-contained fetch handles; hybrid no paging; evidence before wrappers

mcp_tools.name: fetch
mcp_tools.semantics: OpenAI doc {id,title,text,url,metadata}; ambiguous_connection(409)->retry available_connections; self-contained/legacy/pdpp:// ids

mcp_tools.name: read_record_field
mcp_tools.input: oneOf({id,field_path}|{connection_id,stream,record_id,field_path}) + one window selector(cursor XOR offset_chars/limit_chars XOR q/before_chars/after_chars) .strict()
mcp_tools.semantics: Tier-2 content ladder; limit_chars 4096/16384; before/after 2048/8192; next/previous_cursor; cursor bound to record+field+revision+grant

tiers.tier0: compact content[] text: handle,field_path,preview range,read_record_field hint w/args,resource URI
tiers.tier1: structuredContent.content_ladder block per long field: record+field identity, preview status, continuation handles, digest/revision
tiers.tier2: read_record_field bounded field-window tool (only progressive-disclosure TOOL)
tiers.tier3: MCP resources pdpp://record/... & pdpp://field-window/...; self-contained ids preferred; raw URI is compatibility input

content_ladder.invariant: every visible incomplete text preview has a MODEL-CALLABLE continuation (not resource-only); search evidence before wrappers

error_model.envelope: { error:{ type, code, message, param?, available_connections?, retry_with?, resource_metadata?, next_step?, request_id } }

typed_error_schemas.AmbiguousConnectionErrorSchema: packages/reference-contract/src/public/index.ts:1409 (409; required type,code,message,request_id,available_connections,retry_with; emitted by getRecord+getBlob; search/query fan in instead)
typed_error_schemas.OAuthErrorSchema: reference-contract OAuth-shaped envelope for /oauth/*,/consent/*,DCR — distinct from PDPP envelope

soft_signals.related_stream_not_granted: NOT a thrown code; only expand_capabilities[].reason in server/schema-capabilities.js:216. Sibling field_not_granted IS a thrown 403 — asymmetry.

what_caller_sees: GET /v1/schema returns ONLY granted streams/fields/connections (scopeConnectors); ungranted never advertised
granted connections surface as connection_id+display_name; stream names not globally unique->disambiguate via connection_id
ungranted related-stream expand -> schema expand_capabilities[].reason=related_stream_not_granted (inert, not thrown)
ambiguous id across >1 granted connection -> ambiguous_connection(409)+available_connections+retry_with (getRecord/getBlob); search/query fan in
cold-start: GET / and /.well-known/* name next hop; 401 carries resource_metadata+next_step
